name: Striker's Battlegear
bonus4_text: Weapon hits stack 0.65% weapon damage up to 100 times. Counted at 100 stacks.

name: Heartbreaker
bonus4_text: Headshots pulse enemies. Hitting pulsed enemies stacks 1% weapon damage and bonus armor up to 50 times. Counted at 50 stacks.

name: Hunter's Fury
bonus4_text: Enemies within 15m take 20% amplified damage. Close kills disorient nearby enemies.

name: Negotiator's Dilemma
bonus4_text: Critical hits mark enemies. Critical hits on a marked enemy also damage the other marked enemies. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Foundry Bulwark
bonus4_text: A share of damage taken to armor or shield is repaired over time. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Future Initiative
bonus4_text: At full armor you and allies deal 15% more weapon and skill damage.
